# how-to-web Combobox

> Reconstruction guidance for an editable Combobox with a listbox popup.

Use [Build DNA](./build-dna.json) as the normative contract. If the control type is still a product/design decision, evaluate `selection_gate` before implementing custom ARIA.

## Primary

- [Build DNA](./build-dna.json)
- [Combobox reference](./index.md)
- [Research](./RESEARCH.md)
- [Human reference](./)

## Variants

- [Free Text data](./examples/free-text.json)
- [Free Text example](./examples/free-text.html)
- [Restricted Selection data](./examples/restricted.json)
- [Restricted Selection example](./examples/restricted.html)
- [Rich Suggestions data](./examples/rich-suggestions.json)
- [Rich Suggestions example](./examples/rich-suggestions.html)

## Agent instruction

Keep query, popup state, active option, selected value and value policy distinct. Preserve DOM focus on the editable input while navigating the listbox, keep aria-activedescendant valid and visible, and do not override native text-editing behavior unnecessarily. Do not invent automatic selection or free-text/restricted policy.
